user_locked: Keyframe order 图1→图2→图3→图4 across the full 15.000 s timeline.
Opening starts defocused and handheld, then quickly rack focuses into the 图1 composition.
Each keyframe transition uses telescope whip/scanning with motion blur, optical smear and exposure flicker, cutting at maximum blur, then stabilizing and refocusing.

A fixed twin circular telescope-lens mask stays over the whole video with identical position, size, black feathered vignette and soft edges; it never drifts, deforms or moves, and only the content inside it moves.
图2 cloth flaps with restrained breeze while its MINIMAX text undulates and stays readable.
图3 subject walks naturally, turns and swings arms like an unintentionally captured fashion passer-by.
图4 subject shows the glasses-adjustment or slight-chin-lift gesture with a cool, relaxed fashion-campaign attitude.

Red text is tied to focus: initially slightly blurred and low opacity, fading in and sharpening within roughly 0.3–0.5 s, optionally with tiny vertical slide or letter-spacing breath; it exits by fade-out or is carried away by motion blur before transitions, cannot rotate, bounce or fly in/out.
Source core compositions and the source-depicted MINIMAX installation remain unchanged; no new people, vehicles, buildings or logos are added.
Wes Anderson voyeuristic 35mm treatment: fine grain, soft highlight bloom, restrained color, red typographic accents, minimal high-end tone with subtle playful quirk.

reference_anchors.features: city bus-stop installation with white MINIMAX letters on the shelter roof and the matching dark shadow cast on the concrete wall, wide facade, green street sign visible at the left.
low-angle beige high-rise building with a large vertical white banner carrying MINIMAX text, gentle folds, pale sky.
rooftop view with a woman in beige suit, medium-brown wavy hair, white top, red shoulder bag and black binoculars, large concrete facade behind her.
close portrait with short dark hair, red-framed reflective sunglasses, large silver earring and red garment detail.

open_design: Chosen timing: Shot 1 0.000–4.000, Shot 2 4.000–7.400, Shot 3 7.400–11.000, Shot 4 11.000–15.000, each transition overlapping the cut boundary as a fast telescope whip.
图3 action staged inside the source rooftop setting, with the woman lowering/keeping the binoculars to one side while walking so the requested walking, turning and arm-swing remain natural.
图4 gesture staged as a slight glasses adjustment followed by a faint chin lift into a confident, calm fashion-campaign hold.
Restrained city ambience and a light chamber score support the telescope search without inventing dialogue or new sources.

must_keep: All four keyframes in the exact given order.
Each transition is a telescope whip/scan cut with motion blur, optical smear and exposure flicker, then fast stabilize and refocus.
Fixed twin circular mask state over 100% of the duration.
Cloth motion, MINIMAX readability, walking/turning/arm-swing, glasses/chin gesture.
Red-text entrance/exit behavior, no showy text motion.
No added people, vehicles, buildings or logos.

shots.start_state: Twin circular mask fixed; inside the circles the view is soft and defocused, with handheld jitter only in the image content.
shots.action: Image content rapidly sharpens through rack focus into the <Picture 1> bus-shelter composition; red caption materializes with focus, then fades; a telescope whip begins near the end with motion blur, optical smear and exposure flicker.
shots.end_state: At 4.000 the outgoing view is at maximum light-streak blur before the cut to Shot 2.
sound_cues: soft optical click at focus settle
reedy movement and slight whoosh during the telescope whip

shots.start_state: Shot cuts inside continued maximum telescope-blur, then rapidly stabilizes onto the <Picture 2> composition.
shots.action: Low-angle beige facade and white banner lock into focus; restrained breeze carries the cloth in soft waves while the MINIMAX text follows the material and stays legible; red caption resolves, then exits; whip transition begins near the end.
shots.end_state: At 7.400 the outgoing view is reduced to a fast horizontal motion smear.
sound_cues: quieter cable-like optical whoosh during the second whip

shots.start_state: Shot begins from the incoming telescope smear and settles to the <Picture 3> rooftop composition.
shots.action: Woman in beige suit begins walking naturally across the concrete rooftop, turns her head and torso while swinging one arm like a candid fashion passer-by; binoculars hang low at her side; red caption resolves and fades; whip transition begins near the end.
shots.end_state: At 11.000 the outgoing view has reached its maximum blur streak.
sound_cues: fabric brush as the blazer moves
quiet optics click before the whip

shots.start_state: Shot begins from the incoming telescope smear and settles to the <Picture 4> close portrait.
shots.action: Person with red sunglasses looks into view; her fingers touch the frame of the glasses once, nudging it slightly, then she lifts the chin a few degrees into a composed cool fashion-campaign stare; red caption resolves softly and remains restrained until the end.
shots.end_state: At 15.000 the fixed twin circular mask still encloses the calm portrait with no drift or deformation.
sound_cues: soft fingertip contact on the sunglass frame
subtle ambient room tone that closes with the video
